# HUB portal gate v3: portal_gate (hub portals, replaces the rejected world_v1 portal_arch swap)

- Targets: HUB PortalArch_<ZONE> x5 (veil opening 24 wide kept), sign/label readable (owner bug 2026-10-19).
- 2D concept: Higgsfield nano_banana_2 1k 1:1, job `{job}` (see `concept_jobs.json`: refs, prompt, credits). Refs = approved SkyRally concepts / props concepts plus `proportion_guide.png` (flat front silhouette with the required opening). Tripo input `concept_tripo_input.png` = the concept with the dark passage painted out to the background grey (otherwise Tripo closes the opening).
- 3D: Tripo image-to-model task `{tt}` (v3.1, smart_low_poly, face_limit 4500, texture detailed, delight, pbr off, aligned to image), 50 credits. `tripo_task.json`.
- Fit + QC: `win/art_v3_fit.py arch ... 1024 6000 open=open.json depth=9 bury=0.5 clear=0.3 pk=0.75 rect=1` (Blender 4.3 headless on the PC, via `tools/art_v3/run_fit.py`). Opening-aware warp: Z scaled so the raw opening crown lands on the target crown; X remapped per height row so the raw opening edge lands on the required opening (+clearance) and the masonry/timber outside it keeps its proportions (piers x0.75). Small boundary holes closed, welded, triangulated, 35 degree smoothing, 1024 JPEG albedo, metallic 0.
- Result: {tris} tris, {size} studs. Preview `preview.png`, sheet `out/art_v3_qc/portal_gate_vs_concept.png`, stats `stats.json` (opening, colliders, intrusion check), manifest entry in `manifest.json`.
